My recent experience with Dr. Bennett was deeply disappointing and completely unprofessional.

When I received a call back to arrange an appointment, Dr. Bennett spoke to me in an unacceptable manner — impatient, dismissive, and lacking any respect or empathy. I was simply asking if there were any other appointments available this week, and instead of assisting me, Dr. Bennett told me to “take it or leave it” and then hung up on me.

This behaviour was entirely uncalled for. I was polite throughout the conversation and did not deserve to be spoken to in that way. It’s deeply concerning that someone with such an attitude towards patients is in a position of care. Encounters like this are exactly why so many people lose faith in the NHS.

I have now cancelled the appointment because I cannot trust someone who treats patients so poorly to look after my health.
